research_question: Can a source-native Asian Range Sweep signal be combined with a completed-information, direction-symmetric trend state so that Long-Up and Short-Down both contribute across secular regimes and trend transitions?

binding_research_authority.timezone: UTC source timestamps; frozen Rakuten logical server conversion only for H4/D1 state bucketing

signal_contract.upper_sweep_short: completed raw-native M15 Bid high > same-source AsianHigh AND close < AsianHigh
signal_contract.lower_sweep_long: completed raw-native M15 Bid low < same-source AsianLow AND close > AsianLow
signal_contract.entry: first same-source raw tick timestamp >= decision_time; LONG at Ask; SHORT at Bid
signal_contract.exit_boundary: decision_time plus 12 completed M15 bars (3 hours)
signal_contract.exit: first same-source raw tick timestamp >= exit_boundary; LONG at Bid; SHORT at Ask
signal_contract.active_position_suppression: variant-local; reject a candidate signal when its M15 index <= prior accepted signal index + 13
signal_contract.opposite_side_same_day: permitted only when variant-local active-position suppression is not active
signal_contract.both_sides_same_bar: hard ambiguity; event unresolved and gate failure
signal_contract.fold_boundary: signal, entry and frozen exit boundary must remain in the same scoring fold
signal_contract.missing_history: explicit unresolved row; no silent exclusion
signal_contract.lot_economics: 0.01 lot normalized at JPY10 per pip

server_time_contract.dst_rule: US DST from second Sunday in March 07:00 UTC through first Sunday in November 06:00 UTC
server_time_contract.missing_logical_m15: invalidate containing H4 or D1 bucket; no synthesis or forward fill

regime_catalog.input: same-source completed exact-slot H4 Bid close
regime_catalog.ema: recursive adjust=false binary64; first valid close seeds; state unpublished until 24 valid completed buckets
regime_catalog.raw_direction: Up when fast>slow; Down when fast<slow; Neutral before initialization or equality
regime_catalog.transition: the first initialized directional bucket and the first bucket whose directional sign differs from the preceding initialized directional sign
regime_catalog.stable_state: Up or Down only after one additional completed bucket preserves the same directional sign
regime_catalog.permission: Long only in stable Up; Short only in stable Down; Neutral and Transition blocked

regime_catalog.input: same-source completed exact server-day Bid close
regime_catalog.ema: recursive adjust=false binary64; first valid close seeds; state unpublished until 24 valid completed buckets
regime_catalog.raw_direction: Up when fast>slow; Down when fast<slow; Neutral before initialization or equality
regime_catalog.transition: the first initialized directional bucket and the first bucket whose directional sign differs from the preceding initialized directional sign
regime_catalog.stable_state: Up or Down only after one additional completed bucket preserves the same directional sign
regime_catalog.permission: Long only in stable Up; Short only in stable Down; Neutral and Transition blocked

candidate_selection_rule: Among candidates passing every development gate, select the candidate with the highest minimum half-year fold net; tie-break by higher PF, then lower MDD, then lexicographic candidate_id. If none pass, select none.

research_mdd_contract.tolerance_formula: candidate portfolio MDD may exceed baseline only by max(2 percent of baseline MDD, bootstrap 95 percent MDD half-width, JPY500)

core_mt4_authorization.condition: development pass AND frozen candidate AND backward-validation pass
